description:
SUMMARY
Beaulieu House, Cranbury Place, Southampton
Occupying a desirable first-floor position, this beautifully presented one-bedroom apartment offers an exceptional blend of period charm and modern convenience.

DESCRIPTION
To the right-hand side lies the heart of the home - a stunning lounge and dining room. Flooded with natural light from large sash windows, this elegant space showcases a traditional fireplace and offers ample room for both living and dining furniture, making it ideal for relaxing or entertaining.

The kitchen has been stylishly updated with a range of modern wall and base units, providing excellent storage. Complemented by cohesive wood-effect worktops and splashbacks, the space also benefits from an integrated hob, oven and microwave, creating a practical and attractive environment for everyday living.

Positioned on the opposite side of the apartment, the spacious bedroom is another beautifully presented room. Bright and airy throughout, it features a striking bay sash window with a pleasant leafy outlook and benefits from built-in storage solutions, ensuring the space remains uncluttered and functional.

The bathroom is equally impressive, fitted with a bath and shower over, wash hand basin and WC. Finished with elegant marble-effect tiling, it provides a stylish and contemporary feel.

Please note that an AML fee is chargeable to the buyer once an offer is accepted to cover the cost of carrying out the required identity and anti-money laundering checks. Once these checks have been completed, the fee cannot be refunded, even if the property purchase does not go ahead.
